authorization: Freeze benchmark/source evidence and unresolved inputs; no new CFD, hardware, purchase, contact or CAD mutation.

scope.excluded: scaled QxF7, 95 km/750 g design feasibility, legacy alternative-hardware studies

airframe_published.airfoil_label: Selig S3021; use source geometry, not a substituted ideal section

hardware_published.servos: 4 x EMAX ES08 MAII Metal Gear
hardware_published.autopilot: ArduPilot ArduPlane QuadPlane; exact release/parameters unresolved
hardware_published.note: Ground transmitter/ground station excluded from airborne mass/power; listed radio setup is not regulatory approval.

reference_conventions.atmosphere: standard sea-level engineering reference; not recovered vendor flight conditions
reference_conventions.trajectory: steady trimmed level cruise; one departure and one final VTOL landing for mission accounting
reference_conventions.range: one-way total path; not delivery radius
reference_conventions.power_boundary: total battery-terminal electrical power; show shaft/ESC/aux separately
reference_conventions.reserve: seller 10% nominal bookkeeping, once only; not a physical landing qualification

claims.condition: best low-wind optimized; exact payload/conditions unknown
conservative wind/heavier; not our still-air reference

seller_phase_accounting.status: illustrative published values; NOT validated physics or trajectory
seller_phase_accounting.mission_efficiency_rule: If 2.0-2.5 Wh/km is full-mission efficiency, do not subtract phases again; keep alternative interpretations separate.

unresolved_inputs.title: Vendor/build version and source equivalence
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Flightony build revision, modifications versus Flightory packs, and exact as-tested BOM are not established.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Use the hash-frozen supplied standard packs as our source-based stock representation; request build-revision confirmation before calling it an exact Flightony replica.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Source-based analysis may proceed; exact vendor match blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Installed CFD geometry and reference definitions
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Complete native STEP coverage is absent. Tail root placement, root leading-edge datum, exposed boom lengths, actual motor/shaft/prop geometry, gear detail, openings, hinge gaps and assembled exterior quality remain unqualified; published 0.31 m2 is not a recovered area convention.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Reuse original STEP where supported and original STL elsewhere. Audit placements against geometry/manuals; qualify the exterior fluid boundary without erasing real gaps. Replace illustrative hardware with sourced geometry. Retain published area as a documentary reference and separately report measured exposed area.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Whole-aircraft CFD release blocked until selected geometry and approximations are verified.

unresolved_inputs.title: Actual mass, payload inclusion, mass distribution and inertia
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Published approximate 2.9/2.7 kg AUWs do not establish whether 200/500 g cargo is included. Actual pack, printed-part and equipment masses, cargo location and inertia are not measured.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Freeze 2.9 kg Operator and 2.7 kg Explorer total-mass reference cases with cargo inclusion null. Keep unloaded/loaded interpretations separate, not mixed into the nominal cases. Obtain mass breakdown or weigh an exact build; derive uncertainty and inertia from qualified distributions. Explorer 2.7+0.5=3.2 kg would exceed the published 3.1 kg range if AUW excludes cargo; flag, do not assert MTOW.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Fixed-total-mass aero studies allowed; payload claims and dynamics require resolution.

unresolved_inputs.title: CG, trim, controls and allowed CG envelope
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Installed 3D CG, documentary datum mapping, permitted CG envelope, cruise trim/control deflections, incidences and actuator characteristics are not qualified.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Use source/manual geometry to resolve datum and surfaces first. Solve force/moment-balanced cruise with explicitly conditional CG cases; obtain vendor/measured CG and control limits. Do not adopt an old working CG as a measurement or release an invented safe CG range.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Trimmed exact-match prediction blocked; conditional CG/trim sensitivity allowed.

unresolved_inputs.title: Surface condition and manufacturing variation
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Flightony print profile, foaming ratio, paint/coating, seams, roughness and dimensional tolerances are not specified.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Benchmark the vendor LW-PLA/carbon exterior, not the final project Bambu lineup. Run labelled smooth/printed/rough sensitivities supported by plausible bounds; seek build photos and measured surface/shape information. Do not call these statistical confidence bounds.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Conditional drag prediction allowed; tight accuracy claim blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Exact lift propellers and thrust/power maps
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Seven-inch diameter and CW/CCW pairing do not identify manufacturer, SKU, pitch, blade geometry or exact installed F90/prop/ESC maps.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Ask Flightony for prop SKU/pitch and test data on the actual bus. Do not choose a convenient 7-inch prop and label it exact. If unavailable, use separately named candidate sensitivities and seek supervised calibrated lift tests.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Exact hover, VTOL phase energy and blade-resolved lift simulation blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Lift-rotor state during cruise
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Stopped/freewheeling/braked state, actual stop angles and controller behaviour are unknown.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Retain aligned and crossflow stopped-rotor sensitivity cases; add windmilling only with an appropriate model. Use logs/video or configuration evidence to select the representative state. Never count omission of rotors as an aircraft result.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Conditional cruise bounds allowed; single exact drag figure blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Voltage architecture and ESC settings/compatibility
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Actual lift bus, any boost/regulation, BMS path, ESC variants, timing/PWM/braking, calibration and continuous thermal/current limits are unknown. F90 documented 5-6S rating versus advertised 4S pack remains an unresolved qualification gap.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Request the installed electrical schematic/settings and evidence at the actual voltage. Freeze the advertised 4S pack without substituting a 6S design. Analyse low-voltage sensitivity but do not qualify operation from KV or model feasibility alone.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Exact propulsion prediction and physical operation qualification blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Cruise prop/motor/ESC electrical map
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Exact installed forward-flight electrical efficiency, motor constants/losses, ESC losses, wiring drop, prop installation and continuous thermal duty are not measured. Retained APC 10x6E map is manufacturer COMPUTED data, not wind-tunnel validation.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Use retained hash-pinned APC computed advance-ratio map only in-domain; calibrate motor/ESC against exact-hardware evidence. Preserve previous motor-loss and 97% ESC assumptions as legacy assumptions, not new measured inputs. Obtain blade geometry only if powered/blade-resolved CFD is warranted.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Conditional cruise coupling allowed; measured efficiency claim blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Avionics and auxiliary loads
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Actual FC/GPS/RX/servo, DJI O3, Pi Zero 2W and LTE operating loads, regulators and duty cycles are unknown; telemetry-ready does not establish all options installed/active.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Keep core and optional avionics separate. Preserve the old 15 W allowance as one named sensitivity only; obtain rail/terminal measurements or component evidence and run camera/LTE on-off cases without guessing installed status.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Exact total-battery-power comparison blocked; explicit-load sensitivities allowed.

unresolved_inputs.title: Pack/BMS usable energy and landing reserve
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Exact BMS, interconnects, finished pack resistance, cutoff/load curves, cell revision/age/state of health, temperature and delivered Wh are unknown. The retained Samsung document is a dealer-hosted tentative revision, not qualification of this pack. Explorer finished pack mass is unquoted.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Freeze Samsung 50E 4S4P/4S3P nominal 288/216 Wh only as catalogue values. Keep 10% nominal reserve as seller accounting, not guaranteed usable energy. Build a load/temperature-aware pack model from exact evidence and maintain landing power/voltage feasibility. Keep proportional 900 g Explorer mass labelled legacy assumption until sourced.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Seller arithmetic allowed; validated endurance and physical pack safety blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Operating environment and speed definition
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Vendor altitude, temperature, density, wind/turbulence and airspeed-versus-groundspeed basis are not provided.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Adopt a reproducible still-air reference at standard sea-level atmosphere: 15 C, 101325 Pa, rho 1.225 kg/m3; no icing. Reference speeds 54 and 60 km/h are AIRSPEED. Mark this as our convention, not recovered Flightony weather. Add conditions once sourced; cold/rough weather remain separate studies.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Reference calculations allowed; historical flight-condition match blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: Mission boundary and vendor claim accounting
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Range versus radius, phase boundaries, VTOL-inclusive Wh/km, reserve/cutoff, current-meter boundary and payload/speed pairing are not fully established; performance page says estimated scenarios alongside flight-testing language.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Freeze range as one-way total path for this comparison, not delivery radius. Compare steady cruise battery-terminal power separately from mission energy. Preserve both vendor scenario arithmetic and complete phase accounting. Do not subtract VTOL energy twice if quoted Wh/km already includes it; do not force the models to agree.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Documentary claims frozen; definitive claim verdict conditional on definitions.

unresolved_inputs.title: Autopilot and transition model
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: ArduPlane release/parameter set, controller laws, lift/cruise schedule, transition times/altitudes, aerodynamic derivatives, inertia and actuator dynamics are not available.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Defer custom six-DOF/SITL until aerodynamic/electrical model is checked. Keep seller 60/30/30/60-second phases as illustrative accounting only, not a validated trajectory. Request parameter files/logs before reproducing actual transitions.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Full matched dynamic mission simulation blocked; steady studies can proceed.

unresolved_inputs.title: Validation data and measurement uncertainty
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: No independently calibrated exact-build power/airspeed/hover logs, pack discharges or installed drag measurements have been established. Raw sensor calibration, repetitions and independent holdout data are unavailable.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Prefer existing vendor logs or access to a matching aircraft before constructing a second standard Stork. Request raw logs, setup/weather, sensor calibration and ending reserve. Separate calibration and held-out validation. Human-approved supervised tests only if required; no long-range flight presumed authorized.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Prediction possible; independently validated performance and numerical accuracy percentage blocked.

unresolved_inputs.title: CFD runtime, model choices and release criteria
unresolved_inputs.unresolved: Earlier OpenFOAM runtime failed; a working solver is not established. Turbulence/transition treatment, surface meshes, domain/near-wall settings, discretization, convergence criteria and model-form uncertainty are not frozen.
unresolved_inputs.recommended_treatment: Verify runtime on a known case, then a small Stork pilot; retain solver/version and pilot cost. Freeze mesh/domain/wall and discretization criteria before production, using force/moment stability and refinement evidence; distinguish numerical from input/model-form uncertainty. Do not choose arbitrary settings and call them highest accuracy.
unresolved_inputs.gate: Production whole-aircraft CFD blocked until implementation verification; research and geometry audit allowed.

source_inventory.source_integrity: all retained extracted vendor bytes matched prior audit hashes
source_inventory.geometry_quality: original STEP + original STL; hardware proxies and unqualified placements are not exact CFD geometry

change_control.rule: Do not edit this release or tune coefficients to vendor targets. New evidence produces reviewed v2 with change log and rerun affected calculations.
change_control.unknowns: null until evidence resolves; assumptions must be separate named cases
change_control.release_gate: No fully matched/validated claim until applicable U01-U16 gates close; numerical verification alone is not flight validation.
